# Japan itinerary

Two weeks, April 2026.

| Days | Place | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 to 4 | Tokyo | Shinjuku hotel, day trip to Nikko |
| 5 to 7 | Kanazawa | Kenroku-en garden, market |
| 8 to 11 | Kyoto | temples early in the morning |
| 12 to 13 | Osaka | food, then fly home from Kansai |

Hotels hold the passport number for the guest register, have it ready at check-in.

Budget per day for two people is about 20 000 yen without hotels.
